item.title: Flow by Google gets major upgrade: New editing tools, asset grid and video controls added
item.description: Google has announced a major update to Flow, redesigning the platform to bring image and video creation into one unified workspace. The update merges features from Whisk and ImageFX and fully integrates Nano Banana, allowing users to generate and edit high-quality visuals seamlessly.

item.title: Yes Bank uncovers Forex Card fraud linked to Latin America | Details
item.description: Yes Bank detected and blocked a multi-currency forex card fraud linked to Latin America, preventing $0.28 million in unauthorised transactions.

item.title: Tehri Lake Festival: Rafting, trekking, yoga, cultural programs in Uttarakhand from March 6–9, aims to boost tourism
item.description: The Tehri Lake Festival will be held from March 6 to 9, offering rafting, trekking, yoga, cultural programs, and star performances. The event aims to promote tourism and local employment.

item.title: Seasonal infections & pregnancy: What expecting mothers should be cautious about
item.description: Vaccination is another important preventive measure. Doctors often recommend certain vaccines, such as the influenza vaccine, which is considered safe during pregnancy and helps protect both the mother and the baby from severe illness.

item.title: Perplexity Computer brings sub-agents to handle research, docs, data, and APIs
item.description: Perplexity has launched Perplexity Computer, a new system it says can create and execute long workflows using multiple AI models. Users describe an outcome, and the platform breaks it into tasks and sub-agents that can research, draft documents, process data, and call connected tools.

item.title: JSW Motors teases Jetour T2’s arrival in India
item.description: JSW Motors have teased their upcoming SUV, having partnered with Chery to bring Jetour T2 to India which is expected to arrive around Diwali 2026.

item.title: The ePlane Company sets up prototyping, testing facility at IIT Madras
item.description: The ePlane Company has opened a 60K sq ft eVTOL prototyping, testing facility at IIT Madras Discovery Campus. They are building a compact air taxi with air ambulances being the first commercial use case.

item.title: Police order triggered Gen Z protest killings in Nepal: Report
item.description: An order to use lethal force during Nepal’s Gen Z anti-corruption protests allegedly led to the deaths of 19 people in Kathmandu, including a 17-year-old student. The violence triggered nationwide unrest and the prime minister’s resignation. A public inquiry is under way but no official has been held accountable so far.

item.title: Sujatha Devarakonda of TDP elected as Nellore Mayor
item.description: The election officer announced that she was elected unanimously without a contest after the YSRCP corporators boycotted the mayoral election.

item.title: Who is David Blitzer? The new contender eyeing ownership of IPL teams RCB or RR
item.description: US billionaire David Blitzer has entered the bidding war for a majority stake in IPL teams, Royal Challengers Bangalore (RCB) and Rajasthan Royals. His late entry intensifies the ownership race against Avram Glazer and Indian tycoons ahead of the mid-March deadline.
